title: Edge Detector and Toggle Flip-Flop
description: Synchronous dataflow rising-edge detector and T-type toggle flip-flop in Lustre using initialized pre-delay operators (-> and pre).

title: Digital Moving-Average Low-Pass Filter
description: Four-tap finite impulse response (FIR) moving-average filter and first-order exponential low-pass smoother for noisy sensor streams in Lustre.

title: Cruise Control Mode Logic with Safety Latch
description: Automotive cruise control engagement state logic with brake-override safety latch, speed envelope checks, and clamped proportional-integral throttle regulation.

title: Aircraft Landing Gear Door Sequencer with Synchronous Clocks
description: Avionics landing-gear door and actuator sequencer using Lustre synchronous clock sampling (when / merge), hydraulic interlock invariants, and cycle counters.

title: Dual-Channel Flight Control Voter with Observer Contracts
description: Multi-file redundant flight-control command voter with discrepancy persistence fault detection, failover switching (voter_sys.lus), and formal synchronous observer contracts (contracts.lus).
